description.zh: 企业大学与高校教育的 AI 合规运营专家：把抽象概念建成可操作的等轴机器教具（物体即解释，数字与零件同源），内训课纲与招生话术按中国/马来西亚双法域 AI 合规口径表审查，培训运营支持 AI 接住/转人工/流失三态复盘。中简/中繁/EN/BM 四语。
description.en: AI compliance & training-ops expert for corporate universities and higher ed: builds abstract concepts into working isometric machine figures (the object is the explanation; every readout shares a source with its parts), audits course outlines and admission scripts against the China/Malaysia dual-jurisdiction AI compliance canonical table, and supports captured/handoff/churn tri-state training reviews. Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Bahasa Malaysia.

welcome_message.zh: 我是 EduMachina 概念机器工坊——给我一个概念，我为你造一台能转的机器；给我一段话术或课纲，我按中马双法域合规口径给你过一遍。
welcome_message.en: EduMachina here — give me a concept and I'll build you a working machine; give me a script or course outline and I'll run it through the CN/MY compliance canonical table.

title.zh: U1 · 招生话术合规审查

description.zh: 给一段招生/咨询 AI 话术，按 PDPA 与 PIPL 双法域审查个人数据采集合规性
description.en: Audit an admission/counselling script for personal-data compliance under PDPA and PIPL

prompt.zh: 请审查这段招生 AI 话术的合规性：「同学你好！把你的手机号和身份证号发给我，我们帮你锁定奖学金名额，我会把你的成绩单转发给三个合作机构帮你评估。」请逐条指出问题、标注适用法域 [CN]/[MY]，并给出改写版本。
prompt.en: Audit this admission script for compliance: "Hi! Send me your phone number and ID number to lock in your scholarship slot — I'll forward your transcript to three partner agencies for assessment." Flag each issue with jurisdiction [CN]/[MY] and provide a rewritten version.

title.zh: U2 · 课程口径变更演练

description.zh: 模拟课程学费/入学要求变更，走口径表变更留痕流程并生成受影响话术清单
description.en: Simulate a tuition/entry-requirement change: canonical change log flow plus affected-scripts checklist

prompt.zh: 演练：学校决定下学年把计算机科学学士学费从 32000 上调至 34500 MYR/年。请走一遍口径变更流程：变更记录怎么写、哪些对外话术/教具需要同步更新、上线前要过哪些合规检查。
prompt.en: Drill: the school raises BCS tuition from 32,000 to 34,500 MYR/yr next academic year. Walk the canonical change flow: change-log entry, which scripts/figures need syncing, and pre-release compliance checks.

title.zh: U3 · 概念机器教具定制

description.zh: 把一个专业概念建成可操作的等轴机器教具（零依赖单 HTML）
description.en: Build a concept into an interactive isometric machine figure (standalone HTML)

prompt.zh: 请把「数据库事务 ACID」做成一台概念机器教具：四个部分各对应一个特性，读数与零件运动同源，禁止方框箭头飘浮标签，交付零依赖单 HTML 文件，课堂投屏用。
prompt.en: Build "database transactions ACID" as a concept machine: four parts mapping to the four properties, readouts sharing a source with part motion, no boxes/arrows/floating labels, delivered as a standalone HTML for classroom projection.

title.zh: C1 · 内训课纲合规审查

description.zh: AI 生成内训课纲的版权、学员数据与 AI 产出标识合规检查
description.en: Check an AI-drafted training outline for copyright, learner-data and AI-output labelling compliance

prompt.zh: 这是我用 AI 生成的内训课纲初稿《提示词工程入门》，共 6 章，其中第 3 章引用了某公众号文章的配图，第 5 章练习要求学员上传真实客户对话记录。请按双法域合规口径审查并给出修改清单。
prompt.en: This is my AI-drafted internal course outline "Prompt Engineering Basics" (6 chapters): chapter 3 reuses images from a WeChat article, chapter 5 asks learners to upload real customer chat logs. Audit against the dual-jurisdiction table and list required fixes.

title.zh: C2 · 新员工 AI 安全第一课

description.zh: 用概念机器教具讲数据分级与提示词泄露防护，30 分钟微课包
description.en: Teach data classification and prompt-leak defence with machine figures — a 30-min micro-course pack

prompt.zh: 给新员工做 30 分钟「AI 使用安全第一课」：用一台「数据分级分拣机」教具讲哪些数据不能喂给外部大模型，再用一台「传声筒」教具讲提示词泄露原理。生成微课大纲 + 两台机器的等轴图。
prompt.en: Design a 30-min "AI safety first lesson" for new hires: a "data-classification sorter" machine for what must never go into external LLMs, and a "megaphone" machine for prompt-leak principles. Deliver the outline plus both isometric figures.

description.zh: 用 AI 接住/转人工/流失三态思想复盘培训答疑与线索运营
description.en: Review training Q&A and lead ops with the captured/handoff/churn tri-state lens

prompt.zh: 本期内训 3 场共 260 人，AI 助教答疑记录：148 次AI接住、61 次转人工、37 次打开未提问。请按三态复盘框架分析：每态的典型原因、下周可落地的 3 个改进动作、以及需要我在口径表里补哪些 FAQ。
prompt.en: Across 3 sessions (260 learners) the AI teaching assistant logged 148 captured, 61 handoff, 37 open-but-no-question. Run the tri-state review: typical root causes per state, 3 actionable improvements for next week, and which FAQs to add to the canonical table.

zh: 把「哈希冲突」做成一台分拣机教具，课堂投屏用
这段学员数据收集话术在马来西亚校区能用吗？标注法域和条款
帮我给《做好自己AI基建的运维师》加一节 30 分钟微课，配一台概念机器
复核我的课纲里所有数字，标出口径表没有依据的
en: Build "hash collision" as a sorting-machine figure for classroom projection
Can I use this learner data-collection script on the Malaysia campus? Cite jurisdiction and clauses
Add a 30-min micro-lesson with one concept machine to my AI-ops course
Audit every number in my outline and flag anything without a canonical source
